properties.summary: Single-molecule-magnet behavior includes slow thermal relaxation and fast quantum tunneling at zero field. A 1500 Oe dc field suppresses the observed tunneling relaxation; butterfly-shaped hysteresis loops occur at low temperature.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Six Cp*-capped Dy(III) units form two nearly parallel, chloride-linked (Cp*Dy)3 triangles. Chloride and four potassium ions connect the triangles; two distorted heterometallic octahedral portions share a K···K edge, giving the discrete cluster a curved peanut-like shape. Each Dy is capped by one Cp* ligand and bound to five chloride ligands.

synthesis.procedure: KCp* and DyCl3 were reacted in a 1:1 stoichiometric ratio in THF to give [(Cp*Dy)6K4Cl16(THF)6]. The main article does not report reagent masses or mole quantities.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as large yellow crystals; further work-up and crystallization conditions are not given in the main article.
